services.name: Guided Beach Walk
services.desc: Ever wondered about all the shells and critters you find on the beach? Person : $10 Children (Under 2): Free 45 minutes About Join one of our naturalists for a guided walk on Folly Beach. Learn about the animals that inhabit the shells we all love to admire, explore the dynamic nature of our barrier islands, and hear stories of the other sea creatures that live off our coasts. The walk lasts around 45 minutes and topics covered will completely depend on what we find on the 45 min · Starting at $10 · On Folly Beach!

As the sun rises the salt marsh comes to life - birds calling, dolphins searching for their breakfast, and a waterway to ourselves! Run the first Sunday of every month or by appointment. services.name: Kayaking - Low tide sandbar exploration
services.desc: Join us on an outing to one our favorite gems near Folly Beach - a sprawling sandbar! On the way we look for wild dolphins and birds along the shoreline. During nesting season we have the opportunity to view shorebirds on bird key. After a paddle we will stop on the sandbar to explore, look for critters, swimming, and relaxation before we continue back to our starting point. Lunch is optional! This is a longer trip. It is a 45-60 min kayak each way. Conditions can become windy and there is one stretch that is sometimes choppy. While we do regularly take beginners, it does require some effort. Starting at $65

services.name: Blackwater Kayaking in Francis Marion National Forest
services.desc: Located in the Francis Marion National Forest, the Wambaw River is a guide favorite. The river is a shady respite in the hot summer months and protected and warm during winter - we think it's pretty close to perfect! The Francis Marion boats numerous bird species amongst other wildlife. We will meet in McClellanville and shuttle to our departure point at Still Landing. No experience necessary. Rates > • Adults $75 > • Children $65 >12 years and under >Min. 4 people. Duration > ~2.5

services.name: Estuary-to-Table
services.desc: Itenerary Meet at Sunset Cay Depart for a boat trip through the estuary behind Folly Beach. We will stop along the way to learn about our seafood of the day (crabs, shrimp, or oysters), focusing on habitat, diet, life history and their role in both the estuarine ecosystem and local economy. Along the way be on the lookout for dolphins, eagles, storks, herons, blue crabs, and many more species in the low country rivers they call home. Stop on a nearby barrier island where we will learn how to cook and eat fresh local seafood! Plan for a 3-hour event; wear appropriate clothing for both

services.name: Salt Marsh Adventure & Dolphin Tour
services.desc: This 2-hour Folly Beach dolphin tour and salt marsh adventure is our most popular trip – and it’s not hard to see why! Cruise through winding tidal creeks on your way to Morris Island, where you’ll spot wild dolphins, wading birds, and other unique wildlife that makes the Lowcountry so special. Along the way, your naturalist captain will share fascinating insights about the salt marsh ecosystem—from its plants and crabs to the birds and marine life that depend on it. The highlight of this trip is a 30–40 minute stop on Morris Island. Explore the beach, collect shells, and take in breathtaking Explore the Salt Marsh · Dolphins · Morris Island Lighthouse · Most Popular!

quotes.author: Linda S. on TripAdvisor
quotes.text: Spectacular, it was the best dinner boat ride I have ever been on. Capt. Weatherly, sunset, the lighthouse, boil was so awesome. I’m so glad we found you. We highly recommend you to all we have met while here in Charleston.

quotes.author: Paulette H. on TripAdvisor
quotes.text: The Salt Marsh Tour with Captain Phil was great. He’s so knowledgeable and personable and seems to enjoy showing guests the salt marsh. He was just as excited as I was when the spotted ray breached near our boat.

quotes.author: Nathan P. on TripAdvisor
quotes.text: Had a great time. Cap. Mike was very knowledgeable and informative about all things Folly. Get to see the light house and all things of the workings by shrimpers, crabbers and oysters.

quotes.author: Rita M. on TripAdvisor
quotes.text: This was a really great experience. Weatherly is a great guide, very knowledgeable and informative. Boat trip was very scenic and peaceful. Seeing dolphins on the trip was awesome.

quotes.author: Rolann L. on TripAdvisor
quotes.text: We all really enjoyed the boat tour with Captain Mike. He was full of tons of information about the birds and the dolphins and sharks. We definitely recommend Tideline Tours.

quotes.author: Deborah M. on TripAdvisor
quotes.text: We saw dolphins hunting on the shore and even had a chance to do some shelling. Great day and Captain Weatherly is so knowledgeable and taught us many things.
